mapper.update: INSERT INTO ICOMPODT( BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, SELLER, STATUS, SEND_DATE, SEND_TIME, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, BUYER_ITEM_NO, SELLER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, HS_NO, UNIT_MEASURE, ITEM_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, RD_DATE, DOM_EXP_FLAG, MAKER_CODE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_CODE, COMPLETE_MARK, LC_OPEN_REQ_DATE, PR_NO, PR_SEQ, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_SEQ, ITEM_AMT, LC_IF_FLAG, DELY_TO_LOCATION, REF_PR_NO, PROXY_BUY_FLAG, CHANGE_USER_DEPT, AGENT_PRICE, AGENT_ITEM_AMT, PO_REMARK, BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PROCESS_TYPE, CATEG_ID , WAREHOUSE_CODE, ACCOUNT_TYPE, BUDGET_DEPT, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, CMS_CATLG_ID, ST_DATE, DELIVERY_LT ) VALUES ( #{st_buyer}, #{st_po_no}, TO_CHAR(#{st_po_seq},'FM000000'), #{SELLER}, 'C', ' ', ' ', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), #{BUYER_ITEM_NO}, #{SELLER_ITEM_NO}, #{DESCRIPTION}, #{SPECIFICATION}, #{HS_NO}, #{UNIT_MEASURE}, NVL(#{RECV_QTY}, 0), NVL(#{TARGET_PRICE}, 0), #{RD_DATE}, #{DOM_EXP_FLAG}, #{MAKER_CODE}, #{MAKER_NAME}, #{ORIGIN_CODE}, 'N', #{RD_DATE}, #{PR_NO}, #{PR_SEQ}, #{CONTRACT_NO}, #{CONTRACT_SEQ}, ROUND(TO_NUMBER(NVL(#{RECV_QTY}, 0)) * TO_NUMBER(NVL(#{TARGET_PRICE}, 0))), DECODE(#{PAY_TERMS},'LC','N', 'LL','N', 'PL','N',' '), #{DELY_TO_LOCATION_CD}, #{REF_PR_NO}, 'PX', #{PURCHASER_DEPT}, #{AGENT_PRICE}, ROUND(TO_NUMBER(NVL(#{RECV_QTY}, 0)) * TO_NUMBER(NVL(#{AGENT_PRICE}, 0))), #{REMARK}, #{BYIT_COMORG_CODE}, #{PROCESS_TYPE}, #{CATEG_ID}, #{ORIGIN_AGENT}, #{ACCOUNT_TYPE}, #{BUDGET_DEPT}, #{LEGACY_PO_NO}, #{LEGACY_PO_SEQ}, #{CMS_CATLG_ID}, F_GET_DELIVERY_INFO(#{st_buyer}, #{CONTRACT_NO}, #{CONTRACT_SEQ}, #{RD_DATE}, 'D'), NVL((SELECT DELIVERY_LT FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BELOW_COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer} AND CONTRACT_NO = #{CONTRACT_NO} AND CONTRACT_SEQ = #{CONTRACT_SEQ} AND STATUS != 'D'), 15) )

INSERT INTO ICOMPOHD ( BUYER, PO_NO, SELLER, STATUS, SEND_DATE, SEND_TIME, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CONFIRM_DATE, CONFIRM_TIME, PO_CREATE_DATE, BUYER_GROUP, PAYER, NOTIFY, PAYEE, PAY_TERMS, USANCE_DAYS, PAY_TEXT, CLOSE_PERIOD, BLD_1, BLD_2, BLD_3, DELY_TERMS, CUR, PO_TTL_AMT, PO_TAX_TTL_AMT, SHIP_METHOD, DEPART_PORT, ARRIVAL_PORT, OUTGOING_FWDR_CODE, INCOMING_FWDR_CODE, PURCHASER_ID, PURCHASER_NAME, SALES_PERSON, PROCESS_TYPE, ACCOUNT_TYPE, SHIPPER_TYPE, BUYER_BANK_CODE, BUYER_BANK_NAME, BUYER_BANK_ACCT, SELLER_BANK_CODE, SELLER_BANK_NAME, SELLER_BANK_ACCT, VERSION, ADD_USER_ID,CHANGE_USER_ID, EMAIL_FLAG,PR_TYPE,DELY_TO_LOCATION, CHANGE_USER_DEPT,PO_REMARK,AGENT,AGENT_PO_TTL_AMT,DOC_TYPE,PO_SUBJECT ) ( SELECT P.BUYER, P.PO_NO, P.SELLER, 'C', ' ', ' ', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), ' ', ' ',
#{st_po_create_date}, -- 선입고 사용자가 선택한 발주일을 입력함
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), -- 일반발주는 당일날자 입력함
#{st_buyer}, MIN(D.PAYER), MIN(D.NOTIFY), MIN(D.PAYEE), MIN(D.PAY_TERMS), MIN(D.USANCE_DAYS), MIN(D.PAY_TEXT), ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', MIN(D.DELY_TERMS), MIN(D.CUR), SUM(NVL(P.ITEM_AMT,0)), SUM(NVL(P.ITEM_AMT,0)), MIN(D.SHIP_METHOD), MIN(D.DEPART_PORT), MIN(D.ARRIVAL_PORT), ' ', ' ', #{st_user_id}, MIN(USER_NAME_LOC), MIN(D.SALES_PERSON), NVL(MIN(D.PROCESS_TYPE),'G1'), NVL(MIN(D.ACCOUNT_TYPE),' '), ' ', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '1', #{st_user_id},#{st_user_id}, 'N','PX',#{st_dely_to_location},MIN(P.CHANGE_USER_DEPT),
'선입고 ' || MAX((SELECT TEXT1||' '||#{st_change_user_name}||'( '||#{st_change_user_tel}||')' FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C001' AND COMPANY_CODE||CODE = (SELECT COM_CODE||DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=#{st_ref_add_user_id})))||' '||#{st_px_remark} AS PO_REMARK,
MAX((SELECT TEXT1||' '||#{st_change_user_name}||'( '||#{st_change_user_tel}||')' FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C001' AND COMPANY_CODE||CODE = (SELECT COM_CODE||DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=#{st_ref_add_user_id})))||' '||#{st_px_remark} AS PO_REMARK,
#{st_agent}, MAX((SELECT SUM(AGENT_ITEM_AMT) FROM ICOMPODT WHERE PO_NO=#{st_po_no} AND BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND SELLER=#{st_seller})), #{st_gr_flag} ,#{st_subject} FROM ICOMPODT P, ICOMCQDT D ,ICOMLUSR U WHERE P.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND P.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND P.SELLER = #{st_seller} AND U.USER_ID(+) = #{st_user_id} AND P.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = D.BUYER AND P.BUYER_ITEM_NO = D.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND P.CONTRACT_NO = D.CONTRACT_NO AND P.CONTRACT_SEQ = D.CONTRACT_SEQ AND P.SELLER = D.SELLER GROUP BY P.BUYER, P.PO_NO, P.SELLER )
